tasks.commitBody:
An MCP server for the rights model, as commissioned: a VIEW, never a second home. A build-time generator reads docs/architecture/entu-rights-and-visibility-model.md plus the source commit SHA and emits a gitignored rules bundle; rights_rule(id) serves one rule verbatim with its evidence and probe paths, rights_rules(topic) serves matching identifiers, and every response — including empty ones and health — carries the source commit so a stale answer is detectable rather than merely plausible. Minimal JSON-RPC/MCP dispatch and a thin CF Worker fetch entry, pure-node tested; no new runtime dependencies; no auth layer per mitselek's on-issue ruling.

Deployment is deliberately NOT part of this change: wrangler.jsonc and a runbook land here, but activation at mvox.eu (and the path-vs-subdomain routing choice) is a production deployment and waits on explicit PO authorization. #318 therefore stays open at this merge and closes when the server is live.

Part of #316.

(*MVOX:Palestrina*)
